source_doc.title: AXT Inc Q1 2026 Form 10-Q — InP export permit status update (U.S. shipments still blocked)
source_doc.permission_basis: SEC filing is a U.S. public record with no republication restriction; full raw text and extraction may be committed.

sources.locator: MD&A, Economic Challenges, Risks and Uncertainties
sources.quote: InP export permits represent the most significant challenge we currently face.

sources.locator: MD&A, Economic Challenges, Risks and Uncertainties
sources.quote: While we continue to receive permits, we have a backlog of orders for which we have not yet received permits and as of the date of this report we still cannot predict when a permit application will be reviewed and approved.

sources.locator: MD&A, Economic Challenges, Risks and Uncertainties
sources.quote: We are unable to estimate when we will receive the necessary export permits to resume shipping our indium phosphide substrates to the U.S.

sources.locator: MD&A, Economic Challenges, Risks and Uncertainties
sources.quote: On December 27, 2025 China's National People's Congress enacted substantial revisions to the Foreign Trade Law of the People's Republic of China, effective March 1, 2026
All of our substrate products and raw material products are manufactured in the People's Republic of China (PRC or China) by our PRC subsidiaries and PRC joint ventures.

claims.statement: As of the Q1 2026 10-Q (2026-05-14), AXT/Tongmei still has not received China MOFCOM export permits to resume shipping InP substrates to the U.S., and carries a backlog of orders awaiting permits with unpredictable approval timing. U.S.-based InP device makers therefore cannot currently source InP substrates from AXT.
claims.disproof_condition: AXT discloses receipt of MOFCOM export permits covering U.S. customers and resumption of InP substrate shipments to the U.S.

claims.statement: China's revised Foreign Trade Law (effective 2026-03-01) expands government authority to prohibit or restrict exports, adding regulatory tail-risk on top of the existing InP export permit regime.
claims.disproof_condition: Implementing rules exempt compound semiconductor substrates, or InP is removed from the export control list.
